states.title: OlmoEarth Studio
states.body_excerpt: D Toy project - jeju Dashboard Datasets Data Viewer Models Predictions Map Publisher Analytics Tasks Areas Settings Labs My queue Projects Accounts Labs Labs Experimental apps. Subject to change or removal at any time. Annotation Lab Configurable, shareable annotation queues — scope by dataset, task status and assignment Open Change Annotator Pinpoint when a change first appears. Shows a task's imagery window as a contact sheet of satellite passes with no map; click the frame where the change starts, label it, and the annotation takes that pass's date. Includes a binary search for when scanning doesn't find it. Writes to three mutating endpoints, all additive: POST /datasets creates the results dataset (once, from an explicit prompt); POST/PUT /annotations files the validated date as a new annotation in that dataset; PUT /tasks moves the task to to_be_reviewed. The imported estimate it was checking is never modified or deleted. Open Hello Labs Minimal lab proving the framework end-to-end: forwards the studio JWT, calls /api/v1/users/me. Template for new labs. Open Imagery Preloader Preloads a range of zoom levels for one task, then renders the annotation map's imagery from those tiles. Open
